pending_designs.status: CLOSED by PR #158 (squash 9024c51, tag dr-fold-grounding-confirmed, gate 4747; critic re-verify PASS, coordination file s17). OPENED 2026-08-13, NOT BUILT, and it is a DEFECT IN A SHIPPED FEATURE - collection-iteration Slice 1b's. **A FOLD LEAVES NOTHING IN THE GROUNDING GRAPH.** _run_fold_milestone dispatches the reducer DIRECTLY and its signature does not even take mm, so it has no way to ground anything: no RunManifest, no CapacityInstance for the reducer, no DataStateInstance for the conclusion, and no CONSUMES edge from the member verdicts to the conclusion. Proven by running a two-exposure map+fold through execution.run with mm= and dumping every graph in capacity_mm: 2 graphs, both members, reducer absent, conclusion absent. Independently reproduced by the critic lane on f878886 (3-member: manifests=3, reducer_CapacityInstance=0, claim_conclusion_DataStateInstance=0). WHY IT MATTERS MOST: the demo's headline shape is one Record per exposure PLUS a claim-level conclusion, and the claim-level conclusion is the thing a reader cares about most. It lives only on the in-memory blackboard, which execution.run never hands back, so it is UNRENDERABLE. Worse than the map gap it follows: that one made MEMBERS unrenderable, this one makes the ANSWER unrenderable, and with no edge from the verdicts to the conclusion nothing says one came from the other. On the fold, G2 is unavailable and nothing can name what decided. FIX DIRECTION (PR #157's own precedent): route the reducer through the ONE function that grounds - execute_pipeline - rather than adding a third hand-mint; a hand-mint is how _run_member_pipeline came to differ from _run_leaf_pipeline in the first place. ORDER: ahead of the demo home and dr_dump.py, for the same reason the map fix went ahead of it - the dump must show the claim conclusion, and today nothing grounds it. RESOLUTION: the reducer routes through execute_pipeline as a single-step Pipeline built from the plan-named reducer_iri (execution._fold_pipeline; declared outputs resolved scope-correctly), fresh run_ref pipelinerun:{request_id}:{leaf_path}:{run_attempt}. The fold graph now carries manifest + seeded ordered-verdicts DSI + reducer CapacityInstance + CONSUMES + conclusion DSI + PRODUCES, RunStopped(step_failed) on a failed reducer, and a FRESH graph per replan attempt (previously unguarded). ONE CONSUMES edge from the collection DSI, per critic ruling (coordination file s14 Q1 ACCEPT): per-verdict DSIs would invent datastates no plan named and force G7 to bend for one run shape. Which member produced which verdict is order-correlated; the hazard on that is recorded in core-collection-member-dont-know. Tests: tests/phase_48/test_fold_grounding.py (9); six mutations each shown red.
